sentences.text:
228 Fao
 Fao-6272-2016 (O&M)
 Date of Decision: 07.02.2025
Smt. Navita and others .... Appellants
 Versus
United India Insurance Co. and another .... Respondents
Coram: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Nidhi Gupta
Present: - None.

This is the appellant-claimants' claimants' appeal for enhancement of the compensation amount of `13,72,000/- awarded to them by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jind, in a proceeding under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, vide impugned Award dated 12.04.2016.
Perusal of the file reveals that the matter pertains to the year 2016 and notice is yet to be issued on the same.
When hen this case listed for hearing for the first time on 16.12.2016,, the same was adjourned at the request of learned counsel for the appellants.
On the last date of hearing i.e. on 19.12.2022, the appellants have gone un un-represented.
Today, also for the consecutive second time, the appellants have gone un un-represented represented despite the case having been called twice.
Therefore, it can safely be presumed that the appellants appellant or their counsel are not interested in pursuing the instant appeal.

Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
Navita & Ors vs United India Insurance Company Ltd & Anr on 7 February, 2025
